newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Memco, Access Solutions up.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - Memco, Access Solutions up.

text.p: Two initial public offerings had strong showings on Wednesday, posting strong gains at their market debuts.
MEMCO Software Ltd shares jumped four, or over 26 percent, to 19, after their initial public offering.

Access Solutions units rose 3-3/4 to 11-1/4 from their IPO price of $7.50 a unit. The company offered 1,066,667 units, each of which consisted of two shares of common stock and one redeemable stock purchase warrant.
Access sells optical data storage systems that use a proprietary computer output to a laser disk "cold" system to store very large amounts of information, such as a corporation's records.
